characters.name: Tyra Banks
characters.description: The Ace: At the time of the show's original run, Tyra was an immensely successful fashion model, actress, businesswoman, talk show host, and also attempted to launch a singing career. It's no wonder the contestants deeply admired her. Author Appeal: While it wasn't outright stated, she is a bigFan of Underdog. Eccentric Mentor: She claims to want to teach the contestants all the skills they'll need in order to become successful models, but she has, uh,quite interesting ideason how to do so. In Cycle 6, she pretended to faint and actually laid prone on the ground for a few moments before enthusiastically popping back up to announce that she was going to teach the contestants about acting. In Cycle 13, she interrupted a photographer "harassing" the contestants, ripped off her clothing to reveal a superhero costume, and proceeded to chase off the photographer with her "smizing" (smiling with one's eyes) in order to demonstrate the "power of the smize." Elimination Catchphrase:Pre-elimination:Tyra:[The current number of contestants] stand before me. But I only have [the number of contestants proceeding into the next round] photos in my hands. These photos represent those who are still in the running towards becomingAmerica's Next Top Model.After notifying a contestant that they have made it to the next round:Tyra:Congratulations. You're still in the running towards becoming America's Next Top Model. Pre-elimination:Tyra:[The current number of contestants] stand before me. But I only have [the number of contestants proceeding into the next round] photos in my hands. These photos represent those who are still in the running towards becomingAmerica's Next Top Model.

characters.name: Jay Manuel
characters.description: Anime Hair: Known for his spiky white hair, starting in cycle 2. Ascended Extra: He was originally seen as a photoshoot director in Cycle 1 before being promoted to the show's creative director and serving as a guest judge. Put on a Bus: His contract expired after Cycle 18 and he left the show. Straight Gay:Zig-Zagged. While certainly stillCamp, he openly stated that he doesn't need to cross-dress to show that he's proud of being gay. He's also quite masculine compared to Ms. J and wants to be referred to as "Mr.". Stern Teacher: He can be quite rigid with the contestants and if he's dissatisfied with their performance, he lets them know.

characters.name: J. Alexander
characters.description: The Bus Came Back: As stated above, he left the show in Cycle 18 and returned in Cycle 21 as runaway coach and panel Camp Gay: He often appears indrag, both for challenges and on panel. Plus, his nickname is "Miss J." Commuting on a Bus: After being relieved as a panel member after Cycle 13, he occasionally shows up as a guest judge or mentor from Cycles 14 to 18. Costume Porn: J. often appears in a variety of costumes, such as a cheerleader, boot camp instructor, cruise ship director to name a few, not to mention the high fashion outfits he wears to panels and to the final runway challenge. Deadpan Snarker: J. has a dry, sarcastic wit and often comes up with funny one-liners.Joslyn Pennywell (Cycle 11):What is the one, greatest tip that you can give me about runway walking?J. Alexander:Keep your day job.

characters.name: Nigel Barker
characters.description: Caustic Critic: Subverted. While aStern Teacher, Nigel is also able to be aNice Guyto the contestants. Put on a Bus: His contract expired after Cycle 18, returning as a guest judge in Cycle 24. Sexy Mentor: Many of the contestantsSqueeover him. Cycle 6 contestant Joanie Dodds in particular openly states that she has a crush on him. Stern Teacher: He is not afraid to scold contestants if he feels they are being unprofessional, lecturing them on how photoshoots and commercial shoots costs thousands of dollars and so there's no time to mess around.

characters.name: Janice Dickinson
characters.description: Accentuate the Negative: She is quick to point out a contestant's weak points and harps on them until they are fixed. Aloof Dark-Haired Girl: She is generally very cold to the contestants and rarely shows affection towards them. Ambiguously Bi: Enthusiastically kissed Tyra at a Cycle 4 panel. Badass Boast:Janice Dickinson:I AM the world's first supermodel.Janice Dickson [to Nolé Marin]:I was Versace’s muse, I was Valentino’s muse... I don’t know why you are laughing. I don’t know whose muse you were. Brutal Honesty: A trademark of her critiques. She is blunt to the point of rudeness in pointing out a contestant's flaws or shortcomings, especially on their looks.Janice Dickinson (regarding Cycle 1 Kesse Wallace's photo):You look deranged like you just escaped from a mental hospital. Your arms look amputated, your legs look amputated, AND it looks like you have a penis.

characters.name: Twiggy
characters.description: Cool Old Lady: She was already in her fifties when she first started appearing as a judge. Hair of Gold, Heart of Gold: She is considered one of the kindest ANTM judges for being very friendly and warm with the contestants. Even her most harshest critiques were still delivered in a kind manner. Only Known by Their Nickname: Far more people know her as "Twiggy" than by her real name. This was lampshaded during a Cycle 8 challenge, where she explained the origins of her nickname and prompted the contestants to come up with their own. Put on a Bus: She leaves the show after Cycle 9.

characters.name: Paulina Porizkova
characters.description: Accentuate the Negative: She is quick to point out a contestant's flaws Aloof Dark-Haired Girl: Not as bad as Janice Dickinson but she is rather cold with contestants.ShaRaunBrown (Cycle 11):Hi, my name isShaRaunand I AM America's Next Top Model.Paulina Porizkova:[unimpressed]Oh really? Brutal Honesty: She is unafraid to tell contestants if they look ugly or are flat out not suited for modeling. Establishing Character Moment: In her first appearance in Cycle 10, Paulina appeared as a guest judge for the challenge and critiqued each contestant on their appearance. Her critiques ranged from telling Amis Jenkins that she had bad skin and needed to see a dermatologist to telling Dominique Reighard that she looked like "Robin Wright Penn, but a transvestite version." It's no surprise that she was the harshest judge on the panel during her time on ANTM. Put on a Bus: She was fired after Cycle 12,after allegedly not getting along with Tyra.

characters.name: André Leon Talley
characters.description: Badass Longrobe: His signature clotheswear. Camp Gay: As befitting the editor-at-large of one of the most iconic fashion magazines. Catchphrase Insult: "Dreckitude" is his go-to insult for something he dislikes, whether it's a bad photo, a bad outfit, or overall bad attitude. The Dandy: André is always well-dressed, polished, and concerned with refinery. Large Ham: He tends to wax poetic in his critiques, describing the model's photographs.

characters.name: Kelly Cutrone
characters.description: Aloof Dark-Haired Girl: Has dark hair, always clad in black and is really,reallyhard to please. Brutal Honesty: Her nickname isn't Kelly "Cutthroat" Cutrone for nothing! Bullying a Dragon: Any time a contestant tries to talk back to Kelly, they seem to forget she's a judge and has the power to give them a low score for the week, thus increasing their risk of elimination. Calling the Young Man Out: Kelly frequently lectures contestants on the importance of professionalism and delivering consistently. In one instance in particular, she deliversan epic scoldingto Cycle 21's Ben Schreen for attempting to flirt with Tyra during his interview panel:Kelly Cutrone:This is not appropriate. Here’s a little tip: you’re like a pipsqueak, okay? Tyra Banks does not want to sleep with you. And trying to take her down by speaking to her like that is not only delusional but it’s highly unprofessional. Distaff Counterpart: To the judgeshe replaced, Andre Leon Talley due to their fondness of wearing black.

characters.name: Nolé Marin
characters.description: The Bus Came Back: He is a guest judge in Cycle 12. Canine Companion: He would often appear on the panel with his Pomeranian, Empress Mimi. Early-Bird Cameo: He made a few guest appearances in Cycle 2 before becoming a panel judge for the next two cycles. French Jerk: He is often snarky and snobbish in his critiques. Put on a Bus: He leaves the show after Cycle 4.

characters.name: Rob Evans
characters.description: But Not Too Gay: Frequently delivers this critique to effeminate and androgynous male contestants, like Cycle 20's Cory Hindorff. Fake Relationship: As part of an introduction to challenge about how to fake chemistry, he and Tyra pretend to be dating in front of the Cycle 20 contestants. Mr. Fanservice: Many of the contestantsSqueeover his good looks, especially when he appears shirtless. He also appears in a nude photoshoot with the Cycle 20 contestants. Put on a Bus: Leaves the show after Cycle 20. Suspiciously Similar Substitute: To Nigel Barker, the judge he replaced.

characters.name: Johnny Wujek
characters.description: Never Bare Headed: Almost always seen wearing baseball caps or snapbacks with various sayings. Put on a Bus: Leaves the show after Cycle 20. Straight Gay: When Johnny catches Phil imitating him, his only response is, "My lisp is not that bad." Suspiciously Similar Substitute: To Jay Manuel, the former photoshoot director of the past 18 cycles.

characters.name: Bryan Boy
characters.description: Camp Gay: As befitting a fashion blogger, he often dresses in flamboyant outfits. Only Known by Their Nickname: His real name is Bryan Grey Yambao and "Bryanboy" is the name of his fashion blog, which ended up inspiring his nickname. Put on a Bus: Leaves the show after Cycle 20. Suspiciously Similar Substitute: To J. Alexander, the panel's residentCool Teacherto the contestants.

characters.name: Yu Tsai
characters.description: Brutal Honesty: He is unafraid to tell contestants when they are failing during a photoshoot, even though he knows it will shake their confidence. Hot-Blooded: Has a lot of high energy on sets, which translates to aHair-Trigger Temperif his mood sours. NO INDOOR VOICE: He frequently shouts at contestants during photoshoots, especially if they are not performing adequately. Sadist Teacher: Cycle 22's Keith Carlos compares Yu Tsai to his former football coach who would deliberately enrage Keith in order to get Keith to push himself further.

characters.name: Beau Quillian
characters.description: The One Guy: Excluding the guest judges, he is the only male on the Cycle 1 panel. Put on a Bus: He leaves the show after Cycle 1. Red Oni, Blue Oni: The Blue Oni to Janice Dickinson's Red Oni. While Janice would be harsh and blunt with her critiques, Beau was much more mild mannered even with his most pointed takes. The Bus Came Back: He was a guest judge twice in Cycle 7. We Hardly Knew Ye: He only appeared in Cycle 1.

characters.name: Kimora Lee Simmons
characters.description: Beware the Nice Ones: Cycle 1's Giselle Samson thanks Kimora for always having something nice to say during critiques. Kimora's response? "Not always. I'm the devil on the board!" Also, she is not afraid to push back against Janice Dickinson. During an argument whether Elyse Sewell (Cycle 1) has the potential to be the winner, Janice insists a thin girl like Elyse looks like a typical fashion model and Kimora snaps, "But it [ANTM] doesn't have to be 'America's Quest for the Prettiest Anorexic' either." Nice, Mean, and In-Between: Among the main judges, Kimora falls as the "In Between" whereas Beau Quillian is "Nice" and Janice Dickinson is "Mean." Put on a Bus: It was teased that Kimora Lee Simmons would make anappearancein Cycle 14 buta representative from Kimora soundly denied itand she never returned to the show.

characters.name: Eric Nicholson
characters.description: Put on a Bus: Leaves the show after Cycle 2.

characters.name: Adrianne
characters.description: However, according to Adrienne,Revlon refused to use her for their ads, Wilhelmina Models refused to promote Adrienne after ANTM decided to go with a different agency for Cycle 2, and Tyra and ANTM were unresponsive to Adrienne's pleas for help in collecting her prizes.She was briefly sent overseas to model, only to be told that she was too old to book jobs. As such, Adrienne quit modeling and turned to reality television, and her win is rarely acknowledged on the show. Broad Strokes: At least until All-Stars (Cycle 17), where Tyra gave Shannon aRemember When You Blew Up a Sun?speech saying she was a "runner-up" for a reason, acknowledging the fact that therewasa winner on Cycle 1. It is the first time Adrienne was directly referred to on the show, excluding a brief appearance she made in Cycle 2. Dark Horse Victory: Tyra even discussed with the other panel members on how unsure she was about Adrianne making it far in the competition, let alone being in it. In a minor example, Adrianne wins the etiquette challenge, against Robin (who prided herself on being a proper, Christian lady) and Shannon (a Southern sweetheart), much to everyone's surprise. Deadpan Snarker: Often made deadpan, snarky comments in the confessionals.Adrianne:[about Robin]She doesn't seem very Christ-like to me. In fact, I think she secretly worships the devil. The Determinator: After she came down with food poisoning, she was informed by the producers that if she did not appear at the elimination panel, she would be automatically disqualified. Against her doctors' recommendation, she checked herself out early and showed up.

characters.name: Shannon
characters.description: Catchphrase: "Oh my word!" is her go-to phrase for excitement or shock. Chaste Heroine: She is vocal about her promise to stay a virgin until marriage and is oblivious about sex, even expressing surprise that women can masturbate. Chekhov's Boomerang: Her reluctance to do sexy shoots and the critiques from the first photoshoot in Cycle 1 will come back to haunt her in Cycle 17. Eternally Pearly-White Teeth: She has a big white, toothy smile. Extreme Doormat: Shannon often follows Robin's lead, even deciding against the nude photoshoot at Robin's encouragement. After Robin is eliminated and Shannon is shown goofing off with Adrianne and Elyse, she admits that she held herself back to follow Robin's preference for quiet.

characters.name: Elyse
characters.description: The Ace: Elyse was often praised by both the panel and the other girls for her looks, skills and photos. She is also intelligent and speaks French, as seen in the go-sees episode in Paris. Ironically, Elyse was often dismissive of her praise and often complained how "irrelevant" it all was.Adrianne:[about Elyse]She hates everything we do. Yet she's the best at it. Aloof Dark-Haired Girl: She has a jet black pixie cut, a reserved personality, and took awhile to form bonds with the other contestants. Alpha Bitch: Not as much as Robin but she was often mean-spirited in her comments towards the other contestants, most notably in herprofanity-laden rant. Awesome Ego: Not as severe as Robin’s but she was convinced that her higher intelligence and medical school aspirations made her better than the other girls. Bifauxnen: She is noted for her androgynous, edgy look.

characters.name: Robin
characters.description: Alpha Bitch: She is acts holier-than-thou to her non-religious contestants and sets herself up as the leader of the Christian competitors. Big Beautiful Woman: The first plus-sized model ever on the show. Bitch in Sheep's Clothing: She acts sweet and lady-like to the judges, but is actually very rude and intolerant towards others.Robin:Ebony is a lesbian, and I found this offensive. I cannot pass judgment on her, but I just know that some people who claim to love the Lord and are Christian are not always, you know, cut the right way. Cool Big Sis: As the oldest competitor, she acts as this towards Shannon and the other Christian girls in the house. Don't Call Me "Sir": Robin is scolded for using Southern, pageant manners (i.e. saying "yes/no ma'am" and "yes/no sir") and is repeatedly reminded that pageantry is not the same as modeling.

characters.name: Kesse
characters.description: Celebrity Resemblance: With host Tyra Banks. Lampshaded many times during the show, including Tyra herself.Tyra:This is freaking me out. I think I'm looking at my long lost sister.Elyse:[to Adrianne]Do you think Kesse will win? Cause she looks like Tyra. Disappeared Dad: Her father was shot dead. The Face: Of the Christian girls and the top five in general, she is the most charming and personable. The Heart: She got along with everyone in the house and often served as a bridge between the Christian and non-Christian contestants. When she is eliminated, both the remaining contestantsandthe panel cry. After her elimination, the divide between Robin, Shannon, Adrianne, and Elyse widens. I'm Not Here to Make Friends: Subverted. Although Kesse declared this verbatim in one of the first episodes, she ended up being the friendliest contestant.

characters.name: Giselle
characters.description: Genki Girl: Has a young, energetic personality. Graceful Loser: Takes her elimination in stride, pointing out thatBritney SpearsdidStar Searchand lost but still became extremely successful, and vows to do the same. I'm Not Here to Make Friends: She complains that Elyse is not in the competition for the right reasons, pointing out that Elyse's dream is to become a doctor and not a model. Inferiority Superiority Complex: Ultimately became herFatal Flaw. Lazy Bum: Elyse accuses her of being this around the house and refusing to do chores.

characters.name: Ebony
characters.description: Born in the Bronx, New York, Ebony is an openly gay model who previously worked as a make-up artist in the past. Ebony was noted for her striking looks and strong personality but the judges criticized her skin's imperfections. In the house, Ebony frequently clashed with Robin over Ebony's sexuality but Ebony also fought with other house members over her overly competitive nature and inability to take criticism. Eventually, the judges found that Ebony had a large chip on her shoulder that caused her to be difficult to work with, thus eliminating her. Aside Glance: Her hilariousreactionto Robyn's impromptu prayer session. Lipstick Lesbian: She enjoys fashion and make up and is seen doing her girlfriend's hair when her girlfriend visits the house. Motor Mouth: The other contestants view her as this and often complain that Ebony goes on long-winded rants. Never Got to Say Goodbye: Subverted. Though she is seen simply walking out after being eliminated without saying goodbye, unseen footage shows that she writes goodbye letters to other contestants.

characters.name: Nicole
characters.description: Born in North Dakota, Nicole was studying marketing at St. Cloud State University in Minnesota, when she was cast on America's Next Top Model at the age of 19. Initially, Nicole struggled in the competition and placed in the bottom two twice, but the judges saw immense potential in her. Nicole's performance strengthened overseas but it was almost derailed when she got into a feud with Bre Scullark when Bre accused Nicole of eating her granola bars and poured Nicole's energy drinks down in the sink in retaliation. Nicole faced off against Nik in the final two and the judges favored both her walk and her look, proclaiming her the winner. Ain't Too Proud to Beg: In her audition, she got down on her knees and begged to be cast. Art Imitates Art: She posed asthe painting versionofGirl with a Pearl Earringduring the "art imitates art" pictorial. The Complainer Is Always Wrong: Her noticeable flaw and she is almost eliminated during the finalCoverGirlcommercial for complaining about the lights to cover for her nerves. Innocent Blue Eyes: She has large blue eyes, giving her a very youthful appearance.

characters.name: Katie
characters.description: The then 21-year-old from Glenview, Illinois was a college student during her appearance on America’s Next Top Model and did some modeling prior to her appearance in Cycle 1. Katie was frequently criticized for appearing too sexual in her photos and she was finally eliminated after the judges felt that Katie's sex appeal would be detrimental for a career as a fashion model. Ms. Fanservice: The judges chastise her for posing too sexy. She also admits to posing forPlayboyin the past. Statuesque Stunner: She is 5'9''.

characters.name: Tessa
characters.description: Born in Chicago, Illinois, Tessa was an aspiring model working as a waitress and was brought in as one of the two surprise contestants in cycle 1. In reviewing Tessa's pictures from the first photoshoots, the judges felt that she didn't know how to pose well. Tessa's admittance that she disliked posing in revealing clothing further cemented her elimination. Reluctant Fan Service Girl: She admits disliking revealing her skin, even hating shorts, causing Janice Dickinson to point out that she's in the wrong profession if she likes to cover up. Smoking Is Cool: She and Adrianne bonded over being the only smokers in the house. We Hardly Knew Ye: The first girl ever eliminated from America's Next Top Model. Younger Than They Look: She was only 19 during the filming, but appeared older.

characters.name: Yoanna
characters.description: Then 23-year-old Yoanna House was a former babysitter from Jacksonville, Florida. Prior to her appearance on the show, Yoanna lost over 45 pounds in hopes of pursuing a modeling career. Despite her weight loss, Yoanna was criticized by the judges over whether she had a model's physique. She also clashed with CamilleMcDonald, especially after Camille spread a rumor that Yoanna had an eating disorder. Nevertheless, Yoanna's classic yet versatile look and passion for fashion made her a strong competitor, and she was named the winner of Cycle 2. Big "SHUT UP!": During an argument with Camille, she snaps,"I am not finished!" Cool Helmet: Herhigh fashion photoshootduring the final episode saw her wearing this. Formerly Fat: Prior to her appearance on the show, she lost 45 pounds and occasionally worries over whether she has lost enough to be a fashion model, prompting a rumor that she has an eating disorder. Friend to All Children: She used to be a babysitter prior to the competition.

characters.name: Mercedes
characters.description: Mercedes Scelba-Shorte was a college student from Valencia, California and quickly developed a close friendship with April Wilkner. Initially, Mercedes kept her lupus diagnosis a secret before revealing it to the other contestants halfway through the competition. She was praised for her runway walk and sweet personality, but ultimately the judges felt her look was too commercial and she placed second. The Cutie: Has a young, youthful appearance, and was sometimes criticized for looking too "cute" or too commercial. Graceful Loser: Although she joked about pulling Yoanna's hair out and yelling that it wasn't meant to be if she lost, Mercedes's reaction to Yoanna's win was focused on her individual disappointment rather than anger at Yoanna. Heterosexual Life-Partners: With April Wilkner. Older Than They Look: She was 21 at the time of the show, but was noted for looking younger.

characters.name: Shandi
characters.description: Dark and Troubled Past: She admits to having been involved with drugs and was previously arrested for robbery. She also hints to having an abusive childhood. From Bad to Worse: Shandi and her boyfriend have difficulty maintaining their long-distance relationship, with Shandi being jealous of her boyfriend hanging out with a married, platonic female friend. She reacts by flirting with other men, ultimately culminating in sleeping with an Italian male model. Heroic BSoD: She is distraught after the emotional fallout of her cheating and can't focus enough for the photoshoot, resulting in her elimination. Hospital Hottie: She worked at a pharmacy, but close enough. She Cleans Up Nicely: For her makeover, Shandi's hair is lightened and she's given contacts, resulting in a much more polished look.

characters.name: April
characters.description: Brainy Brunette: She studied at the Gallatin School of Individualized Study at New York University, where she graduated with a 3.95 GPA, and speaks several languages. Defrosting Ice Queen: Played with. She is frequently criticized for her cold and analytical nature and she attempts to show her softer side, but fails. Heritage Disconnect: She is half Japanese and half white and admits that she is not very connected to her Japanese side.April: "I'm a mutt, loud and proud." Heterosexual Life-Partners: With Mercedes. Insufferable Genius: According to the judges, she could come off as this at times.Mercedes Scelba-Shorte (about April): "I love her but she's going to die of a heart attack before she hits 27 because she puts so much stress on the little things and doesn't listen to the positive things."

characters.name: Camille
characters.description: Alpha Bitch: Believed that she was better than the other contestants, much to everyone's annoyance. Badass Boast: Her infamous quote below, which also doubles as aSmall Name, Big Egomoment, because Camille said this to apotential clienton the go-sees.Camille:"This is my signature walk. And it's the walk that's gonna make me famous." Beauty Contest: Prior to the show, she competed in beauty pageants and won several titles. Fatal Flaw: Her confidence veers into arrogance and even a visiting psychic warned her that her attitude puts people off. Older Than They Look: She was 25 on the show, but could pass for younger.

characters.name: Sara
characters.description: She was born in Davis, California and was a full scholar at Georgetown University, where she majored in psychology, minored in government and was a member of the Volleyball team. Sara graduated cum laude in 2005. Before she was on America’s Next Top Model, Cycle 6, Sara was working as a Marketing Assistant for the Advisory Board Company in Washington, D.C. Standing at 6 feet, 1 inch, Sara was the tallest contestant among the finalists on America’s Next Top Model, Cycle 6. It was a talent scout who encouraged Sara to audition for the show, but during the semifinals, judge Jay Manuel addressed his concern regarding Sarah’s height. Jay was worried that Sara might not be able to get a lot of modeling jobs, as designers usually do not make clothes for someone who is as tall as she. Supermodel Tyra Banks defended Sara, but still admitted that the average model stands between 5 feet, 9 inches and 5 feet, 11 inches. Nevertheless, Sara made it to the finals, and even though she didn’t have any modeling experience before the show, she was able to impress the judges with her natural talent. She worked her way up to the top 4, and some of her best work includes her runway shows and theCoverGirlcommercial. There were times that her passion for modeling was questioned, which often frustrated Sara, who insisted that she was just as passionate as the other girls. Sara became the tenth finalist eliminated when the judges felt that she was not good enough to be placed in the top 3. Brilliant, but Lazy: How she was perceived, much to her frustration. According to Tyra during the season premiere, she didn't actually audition, instead being chased down by the producers while she was out shopping, and was partway to a law degree when she was on the show. General perception of her seemed to be "great look and lots of natural talent, but acts like she doesn't want to be here." Celebrity Resemblance: The judges commented that she looked likeScarlett Johansson. Hello, Attorney!:In her fourth

characters.name: Catie
characters.description: Ironic Echo: During the semifinals, she claims that she would shave her head enthusiastically if asked. Before the Laundry by Shelli Segal photoshoot, she announces, "I think fear is a complete waste of emotion." Guess who cries when she has to cut her hair short and cries over a fear of heights? Prone to Tears: Jenascia claims that Catie told her that she can cry "at the drop of a hat," causing some contestants to suspect Catie uses her tears for attention. Traumatic Haircut: For her makeover, her hair is bleached blonder and she gets a short haircut, which she isnothappy about it. Why Did It Have to Be Snakes?: Catie's fear is falling to her death and for the Laundry by Shelli Segal photoshoot, the contestants are suspended via wires over a large hole. She spent most of the shoot crying and was barely able to pull herself together when it was her turn.

characters.name: Xiomara
characters.description: Butt-Monkey: Miss J makes fun of Xiomara's walk in front of the others, telling her that she looks like she's on crack. Nolé compares her underwater shoot to "a walrus wearing chiffon." Nice Girl: She comforted Catie during the photoshoot involving heights, even though Xiomara was also scared. Also turns into aNo Good Deed Goes Unpunished, as when Xiomara tries to explain her lackluster performance in the photoshoot was because Jay Manuel was busy comforting Catie, Xiomara is scolded for worrying about Catie and not worrying about herself. It didn't help matters when Catie later threw her under the bus in front of the panel.

characters.name: Jenascia
characters.description: Deadpan Snarker: She had a dry, self-aggrandizing sense of humor.Jenascia:[to Hooters customers]Do you guys need anything? No? Good, because I wasn't going to get it anyway. Fatal Flaw: Standing at 5'7", she was the shortest contestant of the season, something the judges continuously pointed out to her. Heavy Sleeper: She overslept before the first photoshoot, causing her to be late and nearly eliminated. Height Angst: Played with. At 5'7, she was the shortest contestant of the cycle and repeatedly reminded that similar short models like Kate Moss were the exception, not the rule in modeling. However, she retained a positive attitude about her height.Jenascia:Screw it, I’m gonna be short and you guys are gonna like it. No Good Deed Goes Unpunished: She helps April at the first fashion show and after no one wakes her up for the photoshoot, she laments that she thought helping someone would mean someone would help her.

characters.name: Heather
characters.description: Graceful Loser: After her elimination, she shrugs it off, saying, "One man's trash is another man's treasure, I'm trash here and I'll guess I'll go be a treasure somewhere else." Hair of Gold, Heart of Gold: She has long blonde hair and keeps it after her makeover. We Hardly Knew Ye: She didn't make much of an impression on the house and had little screentime. Tag Along Kid: As one of the youngest contestants in the house, she had difficulty relating to the older contestants.

characters.name: Bethany
characters.description: Big-Breast Pride: She is proud of her large bust but is also frustrated that she can't be taken seriously because of it.Bethany: "I hope that people stop looking at my tits and start looking at my talent." Ms. Fanservice: Turns out to be aFatal Flaw, as the judges deem her "too sexy" for a fashion career.

characters.name: Anna
characters.description: Reluctant Fanservice Girl: Refused to pose nude. Southern Belle: Is from Georgia and speaks in a soft, Southern twang. Team Mom: She is the only contestant married with children on the cycle and served as a maternal figure for the other contestants, especially Xiomara. We Hardly Knew Ye: She went home the first week, and since she did not do the first photoshoot, she is the only ANTM contestant to not have an on-show portfolio.

characters.name: Eva
characters.description: The then-19 year old Eva Pigford was the shortest contestant of Cycle 3, standing at 5 feet and 6.5 inches. She made a splash at casting with her confident attitude, which veered into nastiness, prompting Tyra to warn Eva about her attitude should she continue in the competition. Eva appeared to take the advice to heart yet was often at the center of conflict with other contestants, including with her friends Ann Markley and Norelle Van Herk. Nevertheless, Eva's confidence and modelling skills stayed strong, and she was ultimately named the winner. Alpha Bitch: She was unafraid to voice her opinions about the other girls and was often at the center of conflicts at the house. Badass Boast:In the auditions:Eva:I don't compare myself to anyone. I am Eva.During runway practice where the contestants had to walk with books on their heads:Ms. J:Careful. It might fall off. Don't let that happen!Eva:It's not gonna fall. In the auditions:Eva:I don't compare myself to anyone. I am Eva. During runway practice where the contestants had to walk with books on their heads:Ms. J:Careful. It might fall off. Don't let that happen!Eva:It's not gonna fall.

characters.name: Yaya
characters.description: Then-21 year old YayaDaCostahad recently graduated from Brown University prior to her appearance on the show. Yaya's intelligence and pride in her African heritage was occasionally viewed as arrogance, which caused the contestants and judges to be put off by her. Yaya won several challenges and was a strong contender but ultimately the judges felt her personality was too serious and she placed second. The Ace: She graduated from anIvy Leagueuniversity; is shown to be fluent in Spanish, Portuguese, and French; has a dance background; and sometimes moonlights as aCool Teacherto her mom's school. During the competition, she wins five challenges and two best photos. Black and Nerdy: She was a student at Brown University. Brainy Brunette: She is very smart, went to Brown University, speaks several languages, and was often accused of being too analytical. Break the Haughty: She is made to apologize to a fake kente cloth hat that she dismissed as being inauthentic and "bait" from the judges to talk about her Afro-centricity. In Japan, after being nearly eliminated for not being respectful enough, Tyra tells her to "go to the nearest bakery and order the biggest slice of humble pie."

characters.name: Amanda
characters.description: Amanda Swafford had many attributes that made her a unique contestant: at 25, she was the oldest to compete in the cycle; she was a mother of a young son at the time of filming; and she was legally blind, having been afflicted with retinitis pigmentosa, a degenerative eye condition. Although her poor vision could occasionally be a hindrance, the judges noted that Amanda'sbest featurewas her stunning,Icy Blue Eyes. Amanda quickly proved to be one of the strongest competitors, and she ultimately placed third. Blessed with Suck: Her icy blue eyes, which were her biggest asset in photos, were also a hindrance. She had difficulty seeing in low lights and at night, which proved to be difficult during runway challenges. Establishing Character Moment: Arguably also counts as aWham Line.Amanda:I'm legally blind. And I'm going to be about 30 when I go completely blind. It's a disease called retinitis pigmentosa, and I just wanted y'all to know I will always see your face. Please don't cry, I've had 10 years to get used to this. I've seen my son smile and that's all I ever wanted. Cool Mask:Alternate Amanda in the Alter Ego pictorial◊. Horrible Judge of Character: She accused Eva of stealing her laundry and money. She also suspects other contestants of hiding her crystals. And then Amanda remembers she hid her crystals so they wouldn't get stolen andHilarity Ensues.

characters.name: Ann
characters.description: Ann Markley was a NCAA water polo player studying at Mercyhurst College prior to her appearance on the show. Her athletic physique prompted judge Janice Dickinson to nickname her "Ann the Man." Ann was known for her close friendship with Eva Pigford and Norelle Van Herk, which turned bitter towards the end of the competition. While Ann's runway walk was strong, she was unable to produce impressive enough photographs and she placed fourth. Amazonian Beauty: She is one of the tallest girls of her cycle. Beauty, Brains, and Brawn: With Eva and Norelle Herk, which turns intoVitriolic Best Budswhen the competition reaches Japan. Clingy Jealous Girl: Forms a co-dependent relationship with Eva Pigford and has a meltdown when the two are unable to share the same room. Facial Markings: Duringthe Alter Ego pictorial.

characters.name: Norelle
characters.description: Bubbly and energetic Norelle Van Herk entered the competition still wearing braces, which she managed to wear with confidence. She quickly formed a close friendship with Eva Pigford and Ann Markley, which quickly soured towards the end of the competition. Norelle's ditzy nature hindered her in Japan, where she was eliminated due to a poor performance at a Japanese tea ceremony and lackluster photoshoot, placing fourth. Artistic License – Geography:Played for Laughs.Norelle:I don't know if they're called Japanese people from Tokyo or Tokyians? Butt-Monkey: Her ditzy attitude and lack of knowledge of the modeling world often made her the butt of jokes from the judges and the editing team. Cat Girl: She's aHello Kittyfan and does the "cat pose" quite often. Costume Porn: Duringthe Alter Ego pictorial.

characters.name: Toccara
characters.description: Toccara Jones was the only plus size contestant of Cycle 3 and she was noted for her vivacious, vibrant personality. Although Toccara was generally liked by the judges and wonCover Girlof the Week four times, it became apparent that the limitations of the fashion industry for plus size models put a damper on her energy. In particular, Toccara was driven to tears because the stylist couldn't provide decent-fitting clothes on the Ford Mustang photoshoot. Afterwards, the judges noted that Toccara lost her spark and she was eliminated. Badass Boast:During casting.Toccara:My name is Toccara and I'm big, black, beautiful and loving it.During makeover.Toccara:You can shave my head off bald and I'm still gonna walk out here like a goddess. During casting.Toccara:My name is Toccara and I'm big, black, beautiful and loving it. During makeover.Toccara:You can shave my head off bald and I'm still gonna walk out here like a goddess. Big Beautiful Woman: The show'sTrope Codifier.

characters.name: Cassie
characters.description: Then-19-year old Cassie Grisham was a former stripper who struggled with insecurity over the course of the competition. It was eventually revealed that Cassie was suffering from bulimia, and although the other contestants urged her to seek help and Tyra herself offered to provide counseling, Cassie insisted that she was fine. But Cassie's insecurities worsened after go-sees in which fashion designers made blunt comments about her body. Eventually, she was eliminated due to the fact that judges felt that she lost her drive in the competition. Abusive Dad: Her father is a top-notchJerkass. Hooker with a Heart of Gold: She used to be a stripper before joining the competition. Innocent Blue Eyes: Mr. Jay compared her to a Disney character. Ms. Fanservice: She was a stripper before the show and showed off some dance moves during her introduction to the panel.

characters.name: Kelle
characters.description: New York native Kelle Jacob came from a wealthy background and claimed to have been described as a "white girl with a really good tan" by friends. She quickly became disliked by the other contestants, who felt she flaunted her wealth and privilege. Kelle also generated controversy amongst the other black contestants when she said that her biggest insecurity was her "monkey mouth" jawline. Kelle struggled to produce good photographs and she was ultimately eliminated due to the fact the judges felt she did not have enough potential. Big Applesauce: She is from Seagate, New York City's only gated community. Butt-Monkey: To the judges. They often criticized her photos, her looks, personality, anything they could think of that day. I Am Not Pretty: After being criticized for her poor photos in panel, her self-confidence goes down significantly during the course of the show and she admits she is insecure about her "monkey mouth" jawline. I Just Want to Have Friends: Struggled with this in the second episode, as she had trouble making friends with the other contestants.

characters.name: Jennipher
characters.description: Then 22-year-old Jennipher Frost was a bartender prior to her appearance on the competition. She quickly clashed with Eva Pigford and Ann Markley, with whom she almost got into a physical confrontation. After a poor performance at the Dooney & Bourke accessories photoshoot, Jennipher attempted to endear herself to the judges by mooning them with "ANTM" written across her behind. Unsurprisingly, the judges were unimpressed and she was eliminated. Digging Yourself Deeper: She basically dug her own grave when she mooned the judges. Hated Hometown: She is from Pocatello Idaho, and the last thing she wants is to be a "Pocatello girl who gets knocked up and never leaves". It Seemed Like a Good Idea at the Time:Mooningthe panel with ANTM written on her butt was supposed to be a joke.The panel members, obviously, were not amused. Traumatic Haircut: She cried during her makeover even though her hair was only cut to shoulder-length.

characters.name: Kristi
characters.description: Then 20-year-old Kristi Grommet was a college student attending New York University prior to her appearance on the competition. She is notable for wearing her senior prom dress, which she made from an American flag, to her initial audition. Although Kristi had the looks and the body for a model, the judges felt she lacked confidence and she was eliminated. Blonde Republican Sex Kitten: She has long blonde hair, and is a Republican who goes to school in liberal New York. Everyone Loves Blondes: She has long blonde hair, which she described as her best asset. Hair of Gold, Heart of Gold: Blonde and got along pretty well with the other contestants. Only Known by Their Nickname: Her real name is Laura.

characters.name: Julie
characters.description: Julie Titus was the only Indian-American contestant of Cycle 3 and she vowed to project a new image for what a South Asian woman could look like. Julie seemed like she was off to a promising start at the competition but at the judging panel, she admitted that she was more interested in fashion design and starting her own manufacturing company. Unsurprisingly, she was eliminated because she did not appear to truly want a modelling career. A Death in the Limelight: In her elimination episode. Idiot Ball: Exposing her true intentions of joining in front of the judges. Token Minority: She is the first person of Indian descent to compete on the show and one of the few Asian contestants to compete ever.

characters.name: Leah
characters.description: Small-town girl Leah Darrow hailed from a small town in Oklahoma and was eager to prove her ambitions of becoming a model. However, she had unimpressive photoshoots with a photographer noting her inability to make eye contact with the camera. She was the second contestant to be eliminated and she left the competition without bidding farewell to her competitors. A Death in the Limelight: Received a lot of screentime before her elimination Farmer's Daughter: She comes from a small farm in Oklahoma to a strict Catholic family. Hair of Gold, Heart of Gold: She has blonde hair and a sweet personality. My Death Is Just the Beginning: She says this during her elimination.

characters.name: Magdalena
characters.description: From Worcester, Massachusetts, Magdalena was studying nursing at the University of Massachusetts prior to her appearance on the competition. She failed to produce a strong photo at the first photoshoot and was the first to be eliminated, never appearing in front of the judging panel. Hollywood New England: Speaks with a thick New England accent, particularly when she pronounces her hometown (Worcester) as "WOOS-TAH!" Hospital Hottie: she was majoring in nursing at the time of the show. Non-Gameplay Elimination: She was ejected after the first photoshoot and never appeared in front of the judging panel. Spicy Latina: She is of Puerto-Rican descent

characters.name: Naima
characters.description: With her offbeat mohawk and introverted personality, then-20-year-old Naima was originally thought to be a long-shot to walk away with the title of America’s Next Top Model. However, Naima quickly proved to be a strong contender and the judges were blown away by Naima’s final performance on the catwalk. She holds the record of being the first and only Top Model contestant to be votedCoverGirlof the Week nine times in a row. Bitch in Sheep's Clothing: She can say mean words about her friends behind their backs. About Rebecca, for example.Naima:"I'm walking with Rebecca. And all I'm thinking is: "This is bitch next to me"." Beware the Nice Ones: Although she's sweet and quiet, that doesn't mean that she isn't competitive. When she competes against Rebecca in a runway challenge, she says, "There's this bitch next to me and it's either her or me. And it's me." She loses buttakes it well. Broken Bird: Her parents' divorce deeply affected her and she mentions to falling in with a bad crowd while she was working through her anger. Down to the Last Play: Naima and Kahlen were neck and neck towards the end of the competition and then Naima blew it out of the water during the final runway. Tyra describes her win as Naima being the girl who did so-so throughout the semester and "killed the final exam" and Kahlen was the girl who did well all year and then failed the final exam.

characters.name: Kahlen
characters.description: At the beginning of the competition, then 21-year-old's Kahlen’s lack of confidence sometimes got the best of her; however, she consistently produced excellent photographs. At the final judging panel, the judges noted that Kahlen had provided one of the best portfolios in all the previous cycles, particularly the "Seven Deadly Sins"-themed photoshoot in which she had to work through the grief of having recently lost a close friend. But in the end, she was outmatched by Naima's performance on the final runway and she placed second. The Ace: She was a consistent high performer, with Nigel Barker praising her, saying, “You are a chameleon. You have the ability to turn into anything and everything. It’s not sexy, but it’s very cool.” Beginner's Luck: Much is made about the fact that Kahlen had never seen an episode of ANTM or had any prior modelling experience, and yet turned out some of the best photos. Blessed with Suck: Post-show, she exemplified the downside ofCelebrity Resemblancein the modeling world. Break the Cutie: When one of herTrue Companionssince high school died during competition, she took it hard and still had to pull herself together for the ""Seven Deadly Sins"-themed photoshoot that took place in a graveyard.

characters.name: Keenyah
characters.description: Then 19-year-old Keenyah was favorably compared to supermodel Iman early on in the competition and performed consistently. However, Keenyah gained weight during the competition and she was repeatedly criticized by the judges for not maintaining a model's physique. In South Africa, Keenyah got into a fight with the other contestants, including her close friend Brittany Brower, for complaining that Naima should not have received the key to Nelson Mandela's cell. The judges noted the shift in Keenyah's performance and attitude and she was deemed too arrogant, placing third overall. Abhorrent Admirer: Keenyah deals with one in the form of a male model who gets too close during a South African dance photoshoot and grunts in her ear suggestively. Big Eater: Became aRunning Gaglate in the series. Butt-Monkey: After her weight gain, she assigned to pose as "Gluttony" for the "Seven Deadly Sins" photoshoot and as an elephant for the South African animal photoshoot. The Complainer Is Always Wrong: Keenyah attempts to complain about a male model's sexual harassment but the rest of the contestants are already irritated by the way she acted during the visit to Nelson Mandel's cell so they are not sympathetic.

characters.name: Brittany
characters.description: Born in Tallahassee, Florida, Brittany was working with Promogirl.com and was under the management of Marsha Doll Models before her stint on ANTM. She was noted for her loud, vivacious personality but the judges warned that she could appear too sexy in photos. Brittany eventually found her rhythm and received best photo, but her strong performance came to halt when she got into a fight with Keenyah Hill, who was her closest friend in the competition. The judges noticed that she seemed to lose her spark and she placed fourth overall. Big "SHUT UP!": She delivers a loud one to Keenyah when the two get into an argument over whether Keenyah should have received the key to Nelson Mandela's cell in lieu of Naima. Genki Girl: She has a loud, goofy personality, sober or drunk. Hard-Drinking Party Girl: She loves to drink, and occasionally takes it too far, annoying the other girls. Lazy Bum: AsSlothduring theSeven Deadly Sinspictorial.

characters.name: Christina
characters.description: The Tallahassee, Florida native was a student at Florida State University before her appearance on the show. Generally, Christina was a consistent performer who flew under the radar but on the eighth week, she won the interview challenge with hip-hop artist Eve, which gave her a boost in confidence and made the judges take note of her. Unfortunately, the judges perceived Christina's quiet nature for coldness and her inability to show her personality in photos caused her to be eliminated. Aloof Dark-Haired Girl: Played with. Christina is very quiet and calm, which makes her seem aloof even though she's actually friendly. Cool Big Sis: To Kahlen, particularly after when her friend passes away. Gag Lips: Inverted. Her lips were lambasted because they're thin and small. Ice Queen: The judges accuse of her having a cold personality.

characters.name: Michelle
characters.description: Then 19-year-old Michelle greatly impressed the judges with her versatility and talent despite her tomboyish nature. Michelle formed friendships with the other contestants, particularly when she admitted her bisexuality, but her neurotic nature caused some of the other contestants to become frustrated with her. During filming, Michelle developed impetigo and she was ostracized by the other contestants for fear that Michelle had a contagious, flesh-eating bacteria. Michelle fell to the bottom two after the “Seven Deadly Sins” photoshoot and was unable to improve her performance in South Africa, causing her to place sixth overall. Action Girl: She is a professional wrestler. Advantage Ball: Played with. During the Got Milk? ad, Michelle poses with a doll instead of a real child for fear that her impetigo spreading to the child model. The other contestants complained that Michelle had it easier but Jay Manuel notes that Michelle could not play off of a doll in the same way her competitors were able to with their photoshoot partners. Little Bit Beastly: As aZebra◊during her eight and final pictorial. Nervous Wreck: She is extremely neurotic and prone to tears, even having a meltdown when Kelle pretended to close a shoe closet on her as a joke.

characters.name: Tatiana
characters.description: At 18, Tatiana was the youngest contestant to compete on Cycle 4. Her reserved personality did not always sit well with the more rambunctious girls in the group, but she was able to deliver satisfactory photos. However, at the “7 Deadly Sins” photo shoot, the judges felt her performance was lackluster and she placed seventh overall. Celebrity Resemblance: She is noted for her resemblance to supermodel Helena Christensen. Double Vision: AsGeminiduring theWestern Zodiacpictorial. Greed: During theSeven Deadly Sinspictorial.

characters.name: Tiffany
characters.description: The then 22-year-old first appeared in the semi-finals of Cycle 3, where she revealed that she used to be a deeply troubled teenager, having been abused as a child and falling in with the wrong crowd. After the birth of her son, Tiffany vowed to make more positive decisions but she struggled to control her temper. During an outing for the Cycle 2 semifinalists, Tiffany got into a barfight and she was cut from the final cast although she was encouraged to try again. After completing an anger management course, Tiffany was accepted for the cast of Cycle 4. But as the pressure mounted, Tiffany slipped back to her old self, verbally attacking other contestants and having a negative attitude. After refusing to complete a teleprompter mini-challenge in front of the judging panel, Tiffany was eliminated alongside Rebecca Epley. When Tyra perceived Tiffany to be taking her elimination lightly, Tyra called her back to lecture her and lost her temper at Tiffany, creating one of the series' most controversial moments. Broken Bird: She was abused as a child, got into drugs, grew up in poverty (to the point where Tiffany's grandmother forgoed paying the electric bill so Tiffany could have a swimsuit for the ANTM casting), and fell in with the wrong crowd. She admits that she puts up a tough or an indifferent front to hide her pain and anger. Can't Hold Her Liquor: During an outing at a restaurant, Tiffany gets drunk and makes an emotional speech to the other contestants before vomiting. Cool Big Sis: To Brandy. She saw a lot of herself in Brandy and would often try to curb her aggression. Early-Bird Cameo: She was in the casting week of Cycle 3, but was cut before the top 20.

characters.name: Rebecca
characters.description: The then-22-year-old previously tried out for Cycle 2 but finally made the cast in Cycle 4. Rebecca landed in the middle of the pack, winning the runway challenge but not having particularly great photographs. Rebecca's most frequent criticism was that she was not memorable enough and needed to stand out from the crowd. Rebecca was eliminated alongside Tiffany, tying for 8th place. Hair of Gold, Heart of Gold: She got a long weave for her makeover, and she had a sweet personality. Never Live It Down: She is most remembered for fainting at the judging panel,after being told that she wasn't memorable enough. She later appears in Cycle 8 to reenact the incident for a photoshoot. Our Angels Are Different: AsVirgoduring theWestern Zodiacpictorial. Overshadowed by Controversy: Her elimination is overshadowed by the controversial argument between Tiffany and Tyra.

characters.name: Lluvy
characters.description: Lluviana “Lluvy” Gomez was noted for her unique facial features but her insecurities about her unusual looks caused her to produce what Tyra called “the worst photo in the history of America’s Next Top Model.” Despite this, the judges gave her a second chance but Lluvy failed to prove herself in the next photoshoot and she was the fifth contestant to be eliminated. Butt-Monkey: For her infamous Pisces pic being called the worst photo in the show's history. Celebrity Resemblance: To Shelly Duvall, as noted on the show. Former Teen Rebel: Used to be part of a gang. I Am Not Pretty: Does not think of herself as beautiful and thinks she looks "weird".

characters.name: Noelle
characters.description: Then 20-year-old Noelle got into modelling to provide a better life for her young son. Noelle is notable for being the first to sound the alarm about Michelle Deighton’s skin condition and spreading gossip it to the other contestants. Noelle struggled to standout in photoshoots and ultimately, the judges felt that Noelle did not possess the look of a model, in photographs or in person. Bitch in Sheep's Clothing: She wants to make a better life for her son, but has no problems bullying Michelle over her skin problem and turning the other girls against her as a result of mass-hysteria. Little Bit Beastly: AsLeo◊during theWestern Zodiacpictorial. Team Mom: Subverted. She has a young son but is not particularly motherly towards other contestants. Took a Level in Jerkass: When Michelle's skin rash is discovered, she quickly turns the other contestants against her and whips mass hysteria about what her condition is. Then in the "Never before seen" episode, it is revealed that she wished for Michelle to lose as she was leaving the house.

characters.name: Brandy
characters.description: Then 20-year-old Brandy was noted for her fierce attitude, which eventually proved to be her downfall. In the first week, Brandy was almost eliminated for a poor attitude on the photoshoot set and she resolved to keep a better control of her temper, which did not last long. Brandy picked a fight with Tatiana Dante during a challenge designed to gauge how well the contestants would react under pressure and had a negative attitude during the zodiac-themed photoshoot. Despite her strong photos, Brandy was eliminated for her poor behavior on set. Be Careful What You Wish For: Brandy pouted about not receiving a makeover so Tyra and the stylists decided to give her a weave, only to find that Brandy's hair was badly damaged and the only makeover they could give her was to shave her head completely. The Complainer Is Always Wrong: Often complained on set about everything. The judges call her out for her attitude problems but she never seems to take the lesson to heart. Hair-Trigger Temper: It didn't take much for her to lose her cool with the other contestants and even the judges. Little Bit Beastly: AsScorpio◊during theWestern Zodiacpictorial.

characters.name: Sarah
characters.description: Then 22-year-old Sarah Dankleman appeared inStuffmagazine prior to her appearance on America's Next Top Model and felt confident that her prior modeling experience would aid her during the competition. However, when it came to runway walking, Sarah experienced the most difficulty. The judges noted that she was awkward and lacking in poise, and she was the second contestant to be eliminated. "All Grown Up" Remark: During the auditions, we see pictures of her as a frumpy looking-girl. She admits that she was formerly an ugly duckling. Bifauxnen: After hermakeover◊. Bitch in Sheep's Clothing: She appears to be sweet, but she has no problems bad-talking the other girls behind their backs, even referring to Brittany as a "porn princess" when Sarah is eliminated over her (even though Sarah is the one who had previously posed for a suggestive men's magazine!). I'm Not Here to Make Friends: Noelle attempts to ask Sarah what to expect during the 1-800-Flowers photoshoot and Sarah refuses to tell her, saying that no one told her what to expect andThis Is a Competition.

characters.name: Brita
characters.description: Brita decided to enter the fashion industry because she wanted to follow in the footsteps of her mother, a former model. According to Brita, her Latvian immigrant family did not like the idea and attempted to push her towards academics and playing the piano. Despite Brita's enthusiasm, the judges expressed doubt over whether she would have a successful modelling career. At 25, Brita was considered "old" by industry standards and she was also considered overweight. As such, the judges determined that she did not have much potential and she was the first contestant to be eliminated. Hollywood Pudgy: At 5'9" and 138 lbs, she is considered to be "fat" by the fashion industry and the judges told her she needed to lose weight in order to be considered a fashion model. Immigrant Parents: Her parents came from Latvia. My Beloved Smother: Her parents forced her to study every day and to play the piano because they believed modelling was not a serious dream.

characters.name: Nik
characters.description: Then 21-year-old Nik Pace was noted for her strong performance, receiving first call-out three times over the course of the competition and being votedCoverGirlof the Week seven times. However, the judges noted that her range could be limited; she frequently delivered photos in the same profile or 3/4 profile angles. Nik's performance was briefly shaken at Secret Platinum deodorant commercial in which Nik got into a fight with Jayla Rubinelli for "stealing" her line for the commercial. Nevertheless, Nik and Jayla reconciled overseas and her performance stayed consistent. But in the final runway challenge, the judges felt Nik's look and walk were too "bouncy" and commercial, and she placed second. Godiva Hair:In the episode 5 pictorial. Ms. Fanservice: As noted above, her final runway walk was deemed too sexy. Neutral Female: She nearly subverts this with Jayla, but she have great self-control. Only Known by Their Nickname: Her real name is "Erika."

characters.name: Bre
characters.description: Noted for her raspy, sultry voice and spunky personality, Bre won two challenges, was voted Covergirl of the Week twice and received one first call-out during her stint on ANTM. Despite this, Bre had an inconsistent performance, placing in the bottom two five times. She is most remembered for accusing Nicole Linkletter of stealing her granola bars and pouring out her energy drinks in retaliation, which she later reenacted for a Cycle 8 photoshoot. Towards the end of the competition, Bre's performance declined and she placed third. Hair-Trigger Temper: Her fight with Kim shows this. Mona Lisa Smile: During theArt Imitates Artpictorial◊. The Napoleon: At 5'8", she was not the shortest in the competition but the judges noted she tended to look shorter in photos. Only Known by Their Nickname: Her full name is "Brittany" and Ebony referred to her as "Brittany" during auditions, but she went by "Bre" for the remainder of the competition.

characters.name: Jayla
characters.description: The then 20-year-old model from Tucson, Arizona was initially a strong performer, receiving first call-out once and being consistently praised by judge Nigel Barker for her photos. Jayla became close friends with Nicole Linkletter, but clashed with Nik Pace when Nik accused Jayla of stealing her secret for the Secret Platinum deodorant commercial. When the other contestants sided with Nik, Jayla went on a verbal tirade against Nik in the confession room. The two reconciled overseas but Jayla struggled in the competition. After failing to stand out in the Bollywood-themed photoshoot, she was eliminated and placed fourth overall. Bitch in Sheep's Clothing: She is sweet to Nik but regularly complains about her. Rebellious Spirit: She was raised as a Jehovah's Witness, but has no problem with posing nude, smoking, swearing or drinking. Sitcom Arch-Nemesis: To Nik.

characters.name: Kim
characters.description: Then 21-year-old Kim had just graduated from Wesleyan University when she was cast on Cycle 5 and impressed the judges with her fresh, butch appearance and pride in being an openly lesbian model. However, Kim was frequently criticized for letting her masculine side overpower her femininity and for her poor runway walk. Kim quickly became close with Sarah Rhoades and the two kissed in the limousine, but Kim often clashed with other contestants due to her gossipy nature. Towards the end of the competition, Kim received one first call out but then her performance quickly declined, causing her to place fifth overall. Bifauxnen: The judges note that her butch appearance makes her look unique and fresh within the fashion industry. Big Damn Kiss: With Sarah in the limousine, which Kim later reenacts for a photoshoot in Cycle 8. Deadpan Snarker: She often made snarky comments about her competitors in her confessionals. Fiery Red Head: Inverted post makeover. Kim retains her generally calm snarky demeanor.

characters.name: Lisa
characters.description: The then 24-year-old Los Angeles native had been modeling since she was a young teenager and claims to sent her audition tape to America’s Next Top Model as a dare. On the show, Lisa quickly proved to be a front-runner with her modeling experience and knowledge of the fashion industry. However, Lisa's greatest hindrance proved to be her boisterous personality, which occasionally veered into obnoxiousness. She frequently clashed with other contestants in her attempts to give them unsolicited advice and she was reprimanded on the Wild Boyz photoshoot for peeing in a diaper as a joke. Overseas, the judges noted that her attitude had become more arrogant and she was eliminated, placing sixth overall. Abusive Parents: Lisa mentions her mother was neglectful and their relationship is strained. The Alcoholic: Coryn calls her an "alcoholic bitch" during an argument. Attention Whore: Lisa pees in a diaper as a joke to impress the Wild Boyz and Nicole and Bre theorize that Lisa disliked the Wild Boyz not paying attention to her. Breakout Character: Despite only coming in 6th place, she is one of the most memorable contestants and later returns for the All-Star season.

characters.name: Kyle
characters.description: Then 19-year-old Kyle hailed from the small town Dexter, Michigan and claimed to have never met a lesbian before the show. She became good friends with Kim Stolz and Nicole Linkletter while also winning a challenge and first call out for the plastic surgery-themed photoshoot. However, Kyle's performance quickly declined and the judges felt she was struggling to stand out, causing her to be the sixth contestant to be eliminated. Celebrity Resemblance: To Alyssa Milano, especially post-makeover. She was also told at another point that she looked likeAshley Judd. Gender-Blender Name: Kyle is usually a male name. Girl Next Door: Has a sweet, fun personality. Giving Someone the Pointer Finger: During the Secret Aluminum deodorant ad shoot.

characters.name: Coryn
characters.description: Then 19-year-old Coryn was noted for her athletic build, strong features and thick eyebrows. However, the judges cautioned Coryn that she couldn't build too much muscle or else she would limit her modeling potential. Coryn clashed with Lisa D’Amato, who tried to give her unsolicited advice about her appearance. The confrontation jarred Coryn's performance, and when her photograph for a Secret Platinum deodorant print ad was reviewed, the judges noted the sadness in her eyes. Consequently, Coryn became the fifth contestant to be eliminated from the show. Amazonian Beauty: She is tall and muscular, which both Lisa and the judges criticize her for. Beware the Quiet Ones: SeeWham Line. Freudian Excuse: She mentions in her audition that her mother struggled with a drug addiction and she never knew her dad, which makes it difficult to form bonds with other people. Sitcom Arch-Nemesis: With Lisa.

characters.name: Diane
characters.description: Before being cast on Cycle 5, Diane was working for a public defender and hoped to inspire other plus-sized women to be confident in their bodies. Although Diane had much to learn about modeling, she was able to produce satisfactory photographs. However, as the weeks rolled by, and as the challenges and photo shoots became more difficult, Diane became more concerned with her body and image. Tyra felt that her lack of self-confidence not only lessened her chances of winning, but was also sent the wrong message about beauty and self-esteem, causing Diane to be the fourth contestant to be eliminated. Big Beautiful Woman: The only plus-sized model this cycle. Fair Cop: She works as a criminal defense investigator for a public defender prior to her appearance on the show. Fatal Flaw: She gets eliminated for her "fading" personality and apparent lack of confidence with her curvy physique. Spicy Latina: Subverted. She appeared to be this during her audition but she gradually becomes quiet and demure. Tyra calls her out on this, which becomes herFatal Flaw.

characters.name: Cassandra
characters.description: Then 19-year-old Cassandra was a beauty pageant queen, having won several titles in her home state of Texas but she aspired to break into modeling. However, Cassandra proved to be unable to let go of her preferences for beauty pageant standards and she became emotional when she was given a pixie cut for her makeover. Although the judges praised her new look and she received first call out in the photoshoot featuring her new look, Cassandra refused to cut her hair shorter. As such, she became the first person to quit the competition, placing eleventh overall. Aloof Dark-Haired Girl: The other girls accuse her of being "cold" because she does not show her emotions as much and she even claims that she is similar to a sociopath in that she doesn't feel emotions, until herTraumatic Haircut. Beauty Contest: She competed in pageants, often talked about her pageant experience, and was made fun of for it by her competitors and the judges. Butt-Monkey: Was often mocked by her fellow contestants for her prissy nature. Cerebus Syndrome: Said during her audition tape that she would be "easy to work with" and that she would do whatever the hairstylist asked of her, which came back to bite her during the makeovers.

characters.name: Ashley
characters.description: The then 22-year-old aspiring model prided herself on her beauty and during casting week, she proclaimed to the judges that her family had the "pretty gene" and that all of her relatives look like celebrities. However, the judges felt that while Ashley was a beautiful woman, her good looks did not translate into satisfactory photographs, and she was the first contestant to be eliminated. Celebrity Resemblance: Mr. Jay notes she looks like "Charlize TheronmeetsSharon Stone." Everyone Loves Blondes: She is a blonde and proclaims her beauty makes her likeable. I'm Not Here to Make Friends: Despite bonding with Kim during the first episode, she refuses to help her with her makeup during a runway challenge, saying it's a competition. Proud Beauty: She tells the judges how her family has a "pretty gene" and how much she takes pride in her beauty.

characters.name: Danielle
characters.description: Danielle “Dani” Evans is an American fashion model. In May 2006, she won Cycle 6 of America’s Next Top Model. Her prize was a $100,000 contract withCoverGirlCosmetics, a modeling contract with Ford Models and a photoshoot for Elle magazine. Dani was thought by the judges to be one of the front-runners in the competition, noted for her striking face. It was not until the second half of the contest that she came under criticism for her heavy southern accent, which the judges felt was problematic, as the competition winner would shoot commercials forCoverGirl; however, they acknowledged that she could work with a speech coach to eradicate her accent. In the finale, the judges were torn, with some of the judges preferring fellow finalist Joanie Dodds’s versatile portfolio, while others (notably judge Nigel Barker) preferring Evans’s “signature look.” However, they felt Dani had the stronger in-person presence and commanded the final catwalk as well as having a stunning portfolio. Dani ‘s charisma and charm edged out Dodds, and she was crowned the winner of the sixth cycle of America’s Next Top Model. She has been voted by Top Model Obsessed viewers as their favorite contestant ever. Best for Last: She's the last girl feautured on the Cycle 6 OBB. Dreadful Musician:Played for Laughsafter one of the photoshoots. Idol Singer:In her fourth pictorial, which was ironic due to the above.

characters.name: Joanie
characters.description: Joanie is an American fashion model who currently resides in Hollywood, California. She had her debut television appearance as the runner-up on Cycle 6 of the CW reality TV series, America’s Next Top Model. Joanie was accepted into the casting of America’s Next Top Model, Cycle 6. During her session with the casting judges, she dished about how her father is a preacher and how she was a cage dancer under his nose. She was called 5th to join the final thirteen. As a finalist on America’s Next Top Model, Cycle 6, Joanie was known for being humorous and highly talented as a model. She did not get along with her fellow Top Model finalist, Jade Cole, and often made fun of Jade’s age in the confession room. The judges frequently likened Joanie to Top Model, Cycle 3 finalist Amanda Swafford, because both of them have the ability to deliver great pictures, but lack the edge that can make their presence known. Nevertheless, Joanie made it all the way to the Top 2 with Danielle Evans, but even though Joanie was able to produce a great portfolio and did well on the final runway challenge, the judges decided to give the title to Danielle. As a runner-up, Joanie was very classy and showed no resentment towards Danielle or the judges. Genki Girl: Was generally upbeat and could often be seen joking about and cutting up, particularly with Danielle. Graceful Loser: Just four words:Joanie:The best girl won.

characters.name: Jade
characters.description: Born and raised in Philadelphia Pennsylvania, Jade Cole is an Indian and African-American fashion model. Before she was on America’s Next Top Model, Cycle 6, Jade already had some experience as a model in the fashion industry. She was inJay-Zand Pharell Williams’ “Change Clothes” music video, where she got to work alongside supermodel Naomi Campbell. As a finalist on America’s Next Top Model, Cycle 6, Jade became well-known for her notorious personality. The judges and the other girls often criticized her for her arrogant behavior. Jade didn’t see herself as being arrogant, but was always making negative comments about her fellow Top Model finalist, Gina Choe, who was known to be very insecure. Because the judges disapproved of Jade’s attitude, they placed her on the bottom two five times during the season. Nevertheless, her natural talent for modeling brought her all the way to the Top 3, but she was finally eliminated from the show on the season finale. She was the eleventh contestant to be sent home and, in a unique way of saying goodbye, read a portion of her own poem. Alpha Bitch: She caused a lot of drama throughout the season, particularly with Gina. Artistic License – Biology:Jade:Elephants are part of the Dinosaur family. Badass Boast: Too many to count. The "Undiscovered supermodel" and "Not to Be America's Top Best Friend" were probably the most well known.

characters.name: Furonda
characters.description: Furonda Brasfield is a fashion model from Los Angeles, California but she grew up in Stuggart, Arkansas. She encountered some trouble with the law when, in the year 2000, she purchased some materials with counterfeit money from two stores in Fayetville, Arkansas. Three years later, she graduated from the University of Arkansas and went on to pursue a career in modeling. When she was 24 years old, she became a finalist on America’s Next Top Model, Cycle 6. As a finalist on America’s Next Top Model, Cycle 6, Furonda started as a strong competitor. She won the challenge wherein the girls had to use, with young comedian Nick Cannon, what they learned from an improvisation workshop at The Groundlings. Her prize was a guest appearance on the popular CW series,Veronica Marsand the chance to be on a public service announcement about HIV prevention. Despite doing very well on the photo and video shoots, Furonda fell to the bottom two after the “Venus Razor” photo shoot inBangkok,Thailand, and was ultimately eliminated because she could not follow instructions well. She was the ninth finalist to be sent home. I Can't Dance: Part of the reason she got eliminated. The challenge that week involved learning and then performing a traditional Thai dance. When she got on the stage, Stage Fright forced everything she learned out of her mind, and she went into some combination Thai / Hip-Hop / Hula routine that left everybody holding back laughter. Hello, Attorney!:In her fourth pictorial. Later became a human rights attorney in Arkansas after the show. Lovable Alpha Bitch: She was arrogant in the first couple episodes, but calms herself afterwards.

characters.name: Nnenna
characters.description: Although born in Houston, Texas, Nnenna Agba lived in Nigeria for 12 years, only to come back to the United States at the age of fourteen. In 2004, she completed her studies as a chemistry major at the Texas A&M University and before she joined America’s Next Top Model, Cycle 6, she was working as a chemist at a Texas-based oilfield chemical company called Champion Technologies. During the makeover session on America’s Next Top Model, Cycle 6, Nnenna’s head was shaved bald because on the previous photo shoot, where the girls had to be made to look bald, Nnenna was the one who looked amazing with absolutely no hair. The judges saw that Nnenna had a lot of potential, and she was a very strong contender in the beginning. However, as the weeks went by, her performance began to drop, and on the photo shoot in Bangkok, Thailand, Nnenna clearly had a difficult time pulling off the right pose. She was placed in the bottom two, and was subsequently eliminated from the competition. Insufferable Genius: Joanie comments on this at one point, saying that while she is book smart, she lacks common sense (especially when it involves hogging the phone to talk to her boyfriend).

characters.name: Brooke
characters.description: Brooke gave up her senior year of high school in order to participate in America’s Next Top Model, Cycle 7. As one of the youngest contestants, Brooke initially had a bit of difficulty adjusting to the competition and struggled with being homesick and missing her senior year. On what would have been the night of her high school graduation, Brooke was eliminated due to a lack of potential. She placed eighth overall. Post Top Model, Brooke pursued a degree in broadcast journalism and eventually became a producer for ESPN. Coming of Age Story: As one of the youngest contestants, she has to do a lot of work to adjust to the competition and to modelling world. She gets eliminated on the night of her high school graduation. Dramatic Wind:In her third pictorial. Genki Girl: she has a sweet, outgoing, bubbly personality.

characters.name: Leslie
characters.description: Before she joined America’s Next Top Model, Cycle 6, Leslie was studying at Arizona State University. Leslie was only 18 years old when she became a finalist on America’s Next Top Model, Cycle 6, making her one of the youngest contestants. She was roommates with Kari Schmidt and was called “my girl Leslie” by Brooke Staricha. The major criticism that the judges threw Leslie’s way was her all-too sexual look in person. The judges requested that she tone down her sex appeal, and Leslie bounced back during the sixth week, when she came out very strong in a mockCoverGirlcommercial challenge. However, Leslie found herself in the bottom two with Sara Albert the following week, and was ultimately sent home because despite appearing great in print, the judges still couldn’t see Leslie as a model. Motor Mouth: Most notably in herCoverGirlcommercial.

characters.name: Mollie Sue
characters.description: Mollie Sue started out as a strong contender on America’s Next Top Model, Cycle 6. Prior to her elimination on the fifth week, Mollie Sue had been able to produce quality photographs and had never once landed on the bottom two. However, as the competition got harder and as the number of the girls became smaller, Mollie Sue slowly lost her edge over the other girls, until finally, after theCoverGirlcommercial shoot where the girls had to use what they learned from an improvisational class at The Groundlings, the judges decided to send Mollie Sue home for her failure to express her own true “persona” in her pictures.
